sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 140. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: yourself. Applies 30% elevation for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the physical and magic Ability Power of all allies by 20 for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 5000
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the Cost recovery speed of all allies for 40 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 5000
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the Unison gauge gains of all allies by 5 every 10 seconds for 40 seconds.
Only [Cheery Fairies] Tiny Rin & Len can be used as Unlocking Potential material
